description: This file defines an internal generic class BestFitBalancer for balancing resources across buckets using a deterministic, even distribution algorithm. It manages the ideal distribution of resources, computes dynamic distributions based on active buckets, and ensures minimal resource movement during rebalancing.

classes.name: BestFitBalancer
classes.description: A generic internal class implementing a resource balancing algorithm that ensures resources are evenly and deterministically distributed among buckets, handling active/inactive bucket states.

methods.name: BestFitBalancer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ideal distribution of resources over all buckets.

methods.name: GetDistribution
methods.description: Returns a resource distribution for the specified active buckets, redistributing from inactive buckets as needed.
